Figure 3. The workflow of Collaborative Policy Planning (CPP) in the Reasoning Phase. Multiple agents independently generate initial
plans, communicate to exchange reasoning states, and iteratively refine their policies using different tools. Through repeated rounds of
communication and plan updates, the agents collectively vote or summarize to produce a reliable final answer.
